messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: Let's go with AWS EC2 for the backend deployment.

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: We need the release done by Friday 5 PM.

messages.speaker: Bob
messages.text: I'll start the Terraform scripts for EC2 today.

messages.speaker: Charlie
messages.text: Heads up, our startup grant only covers Google Cloud credits.

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: Ok scrap EC2, Cloud Run it is because of the credits.

messages.speaker: Bob
messages.text: Understood, dropping the EC2 scripts and writing a Cloud Run Dockerfile.

messages.speaker: Bob
messages.text: Cloud Run deploy is failing with Error 403 on the container registry.

messages.speaker: Charlie
messages.text: I will grant the Artifact Registry Reader role to Bob's service account tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Dana
messages.text: Anyone up for lunch at the new dosa place?

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: Pushing the release out, Monday 10 AM works better for everyone.

messages.speaker: Dana
messages.text: For my part, I'm owning the load testing plan this sprint.

messages.speaker: Dan
messages.text: We decided to use MongoDB for the transaction records.

messages.speaker: Elena
messages.text: I'm designing the MongoDB collections and indexes.

messages.speaker: Farhan
messages.text: Compliance flagged MongoDB: audits need strict ACID transactions.

messages.speaker: Dan
messages.text: Fine, we are moving the transaction store to PostgreSQL instead.

messages.speaker: Elena
messages.text: Rewriting the schemas as PostgreSQL tables with foreign keys.

messages.speaker: Elena
messages.text: The PostgreSQL connection pool is exhausted, we get Error 503 under load.

messages.speaker: Farhan
messages.text: I'll put PgBouncer in front of the database to fix the 503s.

messages.speaker: Dan
messages.text: Separately, we decided to use Grafana for dashboards.
